verified: PC82–86 resolves SL:GetMetaValue('ITEM_IS_BIND', item): SL is passed as receiver, metadata key is ITEM_IS_BIND, and current BAG_DATA item is the second explicit argument

PC87 tests returned ITEM_IS_BIND value; truthy result falls through to PC88 unconditional jump to PC113, rejecting the current item; false/nil result skips that jump and continues candidate processing
PC89 compares R4 with numeric 1; R4 is initialized to 1 at PC36 and no intervening instruction in the active path writes R4, so the comparison is statically always true
Because PC89 is always true, PC90 unconditionally jumps to PC96; PC91–95 (the apparent name matcher invocation) are unreachable in this function's active control flow

PC96 sets R14=true; PC97 sees truthy and skips PC98 jump, then PC99–112 inserts the candidate; therefore the keyword child closure is created and the keyword table assembled but the matcher call site is dead under the current bytecode

PC1 initializes R0=35; GetDroppedItems returns its ground-item count in R2 (PC10); PC129 tests 35 <= R2, and PC158 increments R2 after each successful discard send; thus the cap is checked before each send and the local count is advanced after send
PC143–156 prepares LuaSendMsg arguments in order: global.MsgType.MSG_CS_MAP_ITEM_DISCARD, candidate.makeIndex, candidate.count, 0, 0, candidate.name, string.len(candidate.name)
PC157 increments R8 once per send, and PC161–166 reports '共丢弃 N 件物品' using R8; this counts successful send attempts/messages, not stack quantity
PC131–136 reports '地面物品已满' and appends the current ground count plus '件，停止丢弃' when the count has reached 35
PC167–169 clears isDiuing and returns after normal completion
